source_contract.whole_profile_digest_rule: SHA256(canonical JSON of schema + collector_version + generation + complete sorted facts map)
source_contract.mutation_boundary: No Frankenstein product module was imported or executed; no product source was modified; the experiment independently reconstructed the observed digest contract from exact source and used synthetic fixtures only.

binding_payload: selected fact records keyed by sorted field_id
binding_candidate.authority_rule: The expected requirement manifest digest must be pinned by canonical consumer/build authority. A runtime/caller packet may not self-narrow the dependency map.

ablation_a_single_value_mutations.interpretation: Under the declared research maps, scoped binding preserves 43/96 unrelated consumer bindings while still invalidating every declared relevant pair. This proves the mechanism's selectivity against the declared map, not the real-world correctness/completeness of the maps.

ablation_b_observed_to_unknown_transitio.interpretation: Changing a required fact record from OBSERVED to UNKNOWN changes the binding because the full typed fact record is hashed. UNKNOWN handling remains a separate acceptance-policy decision and must not be globally inferred from unrelated requirements.

ablation_c_profile_metadata_drift.interpretation: Scoped reuse is not allowed across incompatible profile generation/schema/collector contracts.

ablation_d_requirement_manifest_tamper.critical_result: Requirement scoping is safe only if the consumer pins the expected manifest identity. Without that pin, a narrowed dependency map can create a false-preserve path even though the binding digest itself is internally consistent.

external_primary_source_crosscheck.finding: Bazel action reuse depends on declared action inputs; its documentation also warns that omitted external tools can cause wrong cache hits and that extra environment inputs reduce cache sharing. Structural transfer: exact dependency declaration plus completeness fencing is required.
Linux boot_id is stable during a boot and represents a distinct boot epoch; host identity and boot identity should not be collapsed into one undifferentiated long-lived identity.
wpctl status describes current PipeWire objects including devices, nodes, filters and streams. Structural transfer: this is volatile runtime/session topology, not immutable machine identity.
Nix derivations model outputs as deterministic functions of explicit inputs. Structural transfer only; no Nix import is proposed.

counterhypothesis: Monolithic invalidation remains the safer baseline if exact consumer dependencies are unknown. The E4 mechanism does not prove that the four research maps are complete; a missing real dependency would create stale-evidence preservation.

keep: WP1201 whole-profile digest as complete snapshot/provenance identity
add_after_trigger4_consumer_dependency_a: canonical RequirementManifest with exact field universe
domain-separated RequirementBindingDigest over selected typed fact records
requirement-local UNKNOWN debt and freshness policy
separate HostScopeIdentity and BootScopeIdentity instead of overloading snapshot digest
split_or_demote: pipewire_topology and other volatile runtime/session facts should be a HostRuntimeWitness or minimally parsed capability witness rather than stable host lineage identity
do_not_do: Do not replace the global provenance digest with scoped digests.
Do not allow caller-supplied field maps to define their own authority.
Do not promote the four research maps as canonical consumer policy without source-derived dependency tests.
Do not grant physical-host, installer, runtime, completion or whole-system credit from this synthetic ablation.

efficiency.measured_dimension: invalidated consumer-binding count under single-field perturbation
efficiency.measured_reduction: 43 fewer invalidations out of 96 requirement×mutation pairs (44.7916666667%)
efficiency.expected_runtime_cost: small deterministic canonicalization/hash overhead; must be measured by Trigger-4 if promoted

reason_no_e5: The scoped-binding mechanism passed the declared-map ablation, but the actual F2 consumer dependency universe has not been source-derived and pinned. E5 would overstate evidence.
next_exact_gate: Trigger-4/source-integration audit: enumerate each real WP1201 consumer, derive its exact required field universe from code/tests, pin a manifest digest in canonical source, then run an integration falsifier showing (1) every required-field mutation/UNKNOWN transition invalidates or blocks the consumer, (2) irrelevant mutations preserve it, and (3) manifest narrowing/tampering fails closed. Only then reconsider E5 build-candidate status.
